input:
Earlier scenes:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

This scene:
妈妈认为，住离墓地太近，害得孟子的心气。孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家，跟子思老师住。孟母帮子思打扫房间和做饭。子思帮孟母教她的儿子。因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 住离墓地太近，害得孟子的心气：住在离墓地太近的地方，会害得孟子受到不好的影响，害得Sb. + V.
- 因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书：孟子现在没有朋友，因为他老是读书

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住离墓地太近：住在离墓地太近的地方，The verb for living in a place needs a place phrase introduced by 在. [rule: location_zai_place]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 害得孟子的心气：害得孟子心情不好，The structure 害得 needs a person followed by a harmful result clause; a possessive noun phrase alone cannot express that result. [teacher rule: haide_structure]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 老是读书：一直读书，老是 usually conveys a negative, complaining attitude; 一直 describes sustained reading without that complaint. [vocab list]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 跟子思老师住：跟他住，After the teacher has just been named in the same sentence, use a pronoun for the close re-occurrence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟母帮子思打扫房间和做饭：孟母帮他打扫房间和做饭，Use a pronoun when the same person was mentioned recently and no other possible referent competes. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 子思帮孟母教她的儿子：他帮孟母教她的儿子，Use a pronoun for this close re-occurrence of the teacher’s name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 孟子和孟母搬到子思老师的家：孟子和孟母搬到了子思老师的家，The move is completed before the later actions of living and working there, so the completed action takes 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
8. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书：因为孟子现在没有朋友，所以他老是读书，Use 因为……所以…… to make the cause-and-effect relationship explicit. [rule: coherence_connectives]

items.reason: 住 needs 在 to introduce the location phrase here.
害得 requires a person followed by a harmful result, and 心气 is not an appropriate result here.
老是读书 is acceptable here and can naturally explain why he has no friends.
子思老师 has just been mentioned, so the close re-reference should be 他.
The recently mentioned 子思老师 should be referred to as 他 here.
子思 is a close re-reference and should be replaced with 他.
The move is a completed past event before the following actions, so 搬到了 is appropriate.
Adding 所以 does not fix the teacher-marked reversed causal relation: he has no friends because he always studies.
